allCompleteMessage: You finished every level of today's puzzle.
comeBackTomorrow: A new puzzle unlocks with the next daily set
unavailableDescription: We couldn't load today's puzzle. Check your connection and try again.
completedNoResult: You already finished today's puzzle. Result details aren't available right now.
difficultyStatusUnverified: We couldn't verify which levels you've finished today. The server checks before you start.
notReadyBody: There is no {game} puzzle for today yet. Pick any 3 of today's other 19 puzzles to play free.
startUsesPick: Starting uses one of today's 3 free picks. A game you start stays open all day.

firstAction.sudoku: Tap a blank square, then pick a number 1–9.
firstAction.nonogram: Use the number clues to fill your first square.
firstAction.wordSearch: Drag across the letters of a word on the list.
firstAction.patternMatch: Tap three cards that make a set.
firstAction.crowns: Tap a square to place a crown.
firstAction.duo: Tap a blank square to choose a sun or moon.
firstAction.numberPath: Start at 1. Drag or tap neighboring squares in order.
firstAction.wordGroups: Tap four words that belong together.
firstAction.killerSudoku: Tap a blank square and use its cage sum to pick a digit.
firstAction.wordLadder: Change one letter to make a new word.
firstAction.wordGuess: Enter any five-letter word to get your first clues.
firstAction.cryptogram: Tap a cipher letter, then guess what it stands for.
firstAction.wordBox: Pick letters from different sides of the box to make a word.
firstAction.arithmo: Enter a valid equation to get your first clues.
firstAction.blockSlide: Drag a block or use the arrows to free the target piece.
firstAction.crossword: Tap a square, then type an answer to its clue.
firstAction.pipPlace: Pick a domino from the tray, then tap an empty square.
firstAction.quadWords: Enter a five-letter word for clues in all four grids.
firstAction.wordHive: Make a word using the center letter.
